overview.text: Today's developments span hardware deployment, ecosystem infrastructure, and platform reliability across the AI landscape. First, practitioners can now serve GLM-5.3 at 607.8 tok/s across two Nvidia DGX stations using vLLM, demonstrating high-performance local execution for frontier-scale models. Second, significant discussion emerged regarding allegations that Nvidia engineered scarcity by funding AI startups to buy its GPUs. Third, developers experienced elevated errors impacting claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com. Fourth, model releases and agent tooling continue to advance, highlighted by the trending facebook/sam3 and xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic models on Hugging Face, alongside new open-source agent repositories like Topkiflare74/ai--manus2.0. Finally, OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet to enable secure agent purchases, Google Research detailed Antigravity's /teamwork for science and engineering, and analyses explored open-source AI dynamics and new tooling releases.
